title: Vintage Christmas Decoupage Ornament Set
body_html:
A little Christmas magic, boxed to treasure.

Choose a pair of handcrafted Victorian-inspired Christmas ornaments, a vanilla-scented holiday candle, or both. Your selection determines what is included.

Choose your set

  • Candle only — $17: One vanilla-scented candle in its festive red gift box. No ornaments included.
  • Ornaments only — $48: Two handcrafted decoupage ornaments in a velvet-lined gift box. No candle included.
  • Ornaments + candle — $65: Two handcrafted decoupage ornaments in a velvet-lined gift box, plus one vanilla-scented candle in its festive red gift box.

The ornament pair includes one bronze ornament with a brown bow and one green-and-gold ornament with a green bow. Nostalgic winter scenes, raised decorative details, and hanging loops give each piece its vintage character. The two box photos show different sides of the same pair.

The $17 option is for the candle only. The two-ornament gift set starts at $48.

Ornaments handmade by TRESORA in California. Keep This Feeling.
